About Us

A veterinary-led livestock nutrition business.

JS Feeds & Fodders is a Hasilpur-based feed and fodder supplier serving cattle and goat farmers across Punjab. What began as farm-level consultancy for dairy and goat owners has grown into a dedicated silage, hay, wanda and mineral-mixture business — one where every product is shaped by real veterinary and livestock-management experience, not just manufactured and sold. Our focus stays on the essentials that matter to a working farm: milk yield, weight gain, breeding, and everyday herd health, at fair and consistent rates.

About Dr Abdul Basit

From veterinary knowledge to practical farm solutions.

Dr Abdul Basit is the Managing Director of JS Feeds & Fodders in Hasilpur, and a practicing veterinary doctor with a background in livestock management. His clinical training and hands-on farm consultancy work directly inform how every JS product is formulated — from the silage fermentation process to the mineral mixtures blended for breeding season.

The JS Silage Wanda Factory produces and supplies silage, hay, wanda (compound feed) and mineral mixtures formulated for the specific needs of dairy cattle and goats — from milk yield and weight gain to breeding and growth.

In His Words

Message from the Managing Director

"My vision for JS Feeds & Fodders is simple: to serve farmers with sincerity, quality and consistency. Livestock farming is built on daily decisions, and nutrition is one of the most important of them. We want to make dependable feed, fodder and mineral solutions accessible to cattle and goat farmers while continuing to learn from the farms we serve. Our goal is not only to supply products, but to build lasting relationships with farmers and contribute to healthier animals, stronger farms and a better livestock future."

— Dr Abdul Basit, Managing Director
